entries.message: Open Settings in a browser tab on Mac and iPad, with more room for controls and live sidebar customization
Design Space crests with more heraldic artwork, shapes, patterns, independent colors, emoji, monograms, and a searchable SF Symbols picker
Keep crest previews visible while editing, with faster updates and color choices beside each part of the design
Use clearer route cards, full-width settings lists, matching icon pickers, and labeled data-retention choices
